name: Cartoon réaliste
prompt: Realistic cartoon. Colour, volume and soft light: a dark outline, gradients that turn a shape into a material (porcelain, plastic, steel, fur), one patch of light from the upper left and one of shade. Eyes with a white, an iris and a glint. Each character has its own material and its own palette; no two look alike. Props share the style and the scale of the character that uses them.
